---
title: "Wasday Welay Zainab Saan Hunr Umm Ul Musaib Lyrics 2023"
language: "Urdu"

direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Saqlain"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []

1
Wasday Welay Zainab Saan Hunr Umm ul Musaib Ho Gayiyan Sheraz Khan.
Nana Tazemaan Karbal Wich Ghazi De Naal E So Gayiyaan.
Tatheer Di Aayat Parhdi Hoi Sir Nangay Turdi Sham Gayi.
Aye V Na Putar Nu Aakh Saki Kadon Putar Main Peshiyaan Jogi Aan.

2
Jadon Barish Hoi Pathraan Di Koi Sangh Na Sanghaan Naal Rayi.
Sir Wakhrey Ho Gaye Veraan De Te Chadraan Wakhriyan Ho Gayiyaan.
Tareek Si Qabraan Taun Wadh Ke Oh Wakhri Qaid Sakina Di.
Ik Raat Haneray Wich Nana Masoom Di Sanwaan Kho Gayi Aan.

3
Yaqoob Nabi Da Yousuf Layi Rona V Kaj Nayi Si Nana.
Jitna Akbar Te Qasim Layi Mawaan Putraan Nu Ro Gayiyaan.
 Saqlain Aye Bibi Wain Karey Tainu Kiniyaan Qabraan Dasaan Main.
Karbal Taun Le Ke Sham Taein Jithay Teri Dhiyaan So Gayiyaan.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The Punjabi grammar and vocabulary supported updating the Urdu metadata to `Panjabi` (`pa-Arab`, right-to-left). Both editions have three numbered stanzas of four verses.

The Roman readings “Tazemaan,” “sangh,” and “sanwaan” were ambiguous. I rendered them as تعظیماں, سنگھ, and ساہواں, respectively. Only the selected Markdown file was edited.
